# `esp32s3` control (`control`): every run

A run is one flash of the control image `control-old-default-unrolled-flash.elf`. Each run's value is the median over that boot's complete rounds of the firmware's printed median; the median of the runs is published in `esp32s3.json` and RESULTS.md. Spread is (slowest − fastest run) / median.
